description: For weather delay, this log form records observed conditions, workability thresholds, lost or redirected activity, protection measures, and forecast outlook. Its supporting evidence includes on-site readings, weather source, photos, daily reports, schedule fragment, and mitigation record.

blocks.guidance: Link this weather delay record to its evidence.
